quotes.text: The function is about the status of a key, not about a signature.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Review-backed and applied in RNP: name a helper for the key's revocation reason rather than a signature when the result describes key status. Use names that state the actual data and lookup key.
title: Name OpenPGP helpers for the value they return
